name: clangsay
title: clangsay (a C reimplementation of cowsay)
_doc: NOT an original source, and further from one than any other target here: cowsay itself is a PERL script (Tony Monroe, 1999) and a Unix program, so there is no 1990s C behind this at all -- sasairc wrote clangsay in 2016. It says nothing about the project's claim that original source runs; what it is worth is a SMOKE TEST of the plain hosted-C surface, 1,479 lines with no graphics, no devices and no data. It earned that on its first build by exposing a Duff's device in libbenly that PRISM emitted as JavaScript the engine would not parse.
_defines: COWPATH is where it looks for .cow files; the data directory is what the user names.
_units: clangsay plus the units of libbenly it actually calls -- strrep, smalloc, free2d, load_file_to_array. The library is a submodule the project declares, fetched rather than stubbed.
